title: New Networking is Fun
description:
Networking is a weird scary term but you hear it everywhere in the sense of “network you way to a job”. It’s good news then that the old way of networking isn’t the only way anymore. Simply being active and engaged with the conversations going on in your industry and making connections (not always LinkedIn literally) with potential colleagues is a great low pressure way to network. #networking #networkingtips #networkmarketing #linkedin #linkedintips #careergrowth #jobseeker

transcript: you're probably networking every single day and you don't even realize it I feel like the old thinking around networking is that it's like really formal LinkedIn connections like in-person Meetup stuff all that is good but just like talking to people on social media that's also networking I do that like every single day without even thinking twice about it now granted that's like my personal interests for sure but what if you did that on the platforms and in the circles where your job is just casually talking with people on LinkedIn YouTube Twitter wherever other social media platforms building new relationships that way that's kind of how you want to think about networking
